notes.title: WDC Charity Sale - Rush on and Save the Whales!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that once again, we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation, for World Ocean Day!   

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, and you can save a fin-tastic 30% off Kingdom Rush, Kingdom Rush Origins, Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance, Iron Marines, Iron Marines Invasion, and Legends of Kingdom Rush. We will donate 10% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* 


[h2]Who is WDC?[/h2]
[b]WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation[/b] is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.
Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic creatures.

Entanglement in fishing gear, or ‘bycatch’ as it’s known, is the biggest threat whales and dolphins face. Many hundreds of thousands die in nets or get tangled up in fishing gear every year. As air-breathing mammals like us, when they get trapped in a net, panic can take over and they can sustain terrible injuries before either escaping, or suffocating. It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  


[h2]What WDC has been doing so far 
[/h2]Working across the globe to protect whales, dolphins and porpoises from dying in fishing gear: 
[list]
[*] They’re collaborating with creel fishers in Scotland to trial new types of fishing gear to reduce entanglements of humpback and minke whales. 
[*] They’re working with colleagues and partner organisations in the Central Baltic Sea to develop a recovery plan for a critically endangered group of Baltic harbour porpoises. 
[*] On the west coast of the United States, critically endangered North Atlantic right whales are facing extinction. Entanglement is a massive threat to their survival, and WDC have been working with fishers to trial alternative gear types. 
[*] In Hong Kong WDC have been supporting local community efforts and working with fishers to save the remaining 200 Indo-Pacific finless porpoises from extinction due to bycatch.   
[*] These projects are saving lives, and they are powered by inspiring people working together for the ocean. 
[/list]

[h2]How your support will help this year
[/h2]By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue these vital conservation projects across the globe, as well as enable WDC’s team to embark on new efforts to bring further protections for whales and dolphins, like the Sri Lankan gillnet fisheries project: 
[list]
[*]  Sri Lanka is home to many species of whales, dolphins and porpoises as well as a myriad of other sensitive marine species like sea turtles that are vulnerable to entanglement in gillnets – these are nets that hang in the water like a wall. With funding, WDC hopes to collaborate with Sri Lankan artisanal tuna fisheries that use gillnets to trial new gear types and reduce the impact their fishing has on marine life, while still enabling them to earn their living. 
[/list]

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused. 

[b]If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so [url=https://whales.org/ ]here![/url][/b]
Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does [url=https://games.whales.org/ ]here.[/url]
And you can find many other amazing games in the sale [url=https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale25]here.[/url]

[b]Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! [/b]
*10% of our net revenue from this sale will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).

[h2]Scoring system
[/h2] Earn points based on your performance in each challenge, with your score carrying over the two rounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5487830/c1a9fec0c21293377c57d02b6f9438067ba06cc1.png[/img]
❤️ [b]Remaining Lives[/b] (max 20 points): 1 point per heart left. Example: 18 lives = 18 points. 
🪙 [b]Remaining Gold[/b] (max 20 points): (Remaining Gold / Max Stage Gold) × 20.
⌛ [b]Time Points[/b] (max 10 points): 15 minutes equals 10 points, every extra minute deducts 1 point.
🌟 [b]FLAWLESS VICTORY! [/b]Finish with 20 hearts to get your Total Challenge Points multiplied by x1.5!

notes.title: KINGDOM RUSH 5: ALLIANCE, the next chapter in the saga, is on its way!
notes.content:
[b]We have a very big announcement to make!![/b]
[h1]Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance is coming soon![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5487830/ba174cace2fdbf6ea8c9888a09f3a1fa1ded2ab6.png[/img]

We’re cooking. And not spaghetti.  
Okay, maybe sometimes it’s spaghetti, but that's beside the point. What we mean is [b]the next Kingdom Rush game is in the works![/b]

Is it a Tower Defense? Absolutely. Is it full of our signature charm, gags and epic action? [i]You betcha![/i]
Have you seen the teaser? Check it out if you haven't already, or watch it again (we won't judge).

[previewyoutube=DhpkLRd8MJs;full][/previewyoutube]

We're still figuring out how to time-travel to the future to get the release date.

In the meantime, you can stay updated with all the juicy development details by subscribing to the newsletter. There are perks like gifts and Sneak Peeks over there… just saying!

notes.title: The Hammerhold Campaign DLC is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5487830/658fea414d298df08be9e42a05b4f44498ceb8f5.jpg[/img]

Did my ears deceive me? King Malik?[b] KING MALIK[/b]? [b]The audacity! [/b]Have they all taken leave of their senses, forgetting the true sovereign that reigns supreme in this Kingdom?

Did they ACTUALLY believe Hammerhold could stand a chance against my Dark Army? Until now, I merely dismissed them, occupied with more important matters. But no longer.

Now, General, seize the hour! Lead a surprise assault on the desert’s shores, catching them off guard. Let’s wake them up from their delusions and get this little rebellion done and over with.

[b]Let our dark dominance be absolute! 
[i]Take my Vengeance to Hammerhold once and for all!![/i][/b]


[h3]What's in the Hammerhold DLC:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]5 new stages:[/b] A whole new campaign packed with action and powerful enemies. 
[*] [b]3 minibosses and 1 boss: [/b]Familiar faces are back… and they’re not thrilled to see you!
[*] [b]New hero: [/b] Behold Isfet, a formidable mummy warlock with an arsenal of curses. 
[*] [b]New tower:[/b] The Sandworm Hollows' appetites are (mostly) at your disposal.
[*] [b]New achievements: [/b]And savor the sweet taste of bragging rights that come with them!
[*] [b]Easter eggs galore: [/b]The desert may hold secrets, but it also has a sense of humor.
[/list]

[b]Get it now:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695220/Kingdom_Rush_Vengeance__Hammerhold_Campaign/

notes.title: The Primal Ravage update is here
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5487830/7d2120a0fb52093c577888d23b61102b4ed82e3b.png[/img]

General!

The day has arrived and our new update,  Primal Ravage, is now available!
Go now and take command of my troops and show them those unworthy dwarves and dinosaurs who the rightful ruler of this land is!

I am pretty sure they will get petrified once they see you charge, and those dwarves will not be a BIG problem, for sure!

In this new adventure you will have to face 3 new stages with a thrilling boss fight. You can count on the aid of a new tower and a new hero I’m leaving at your disposal!

Get ready as there are new enemies on the rise but you can also unlock 4 new achievements!

I am done with the talking, go now and fulfill my revenge!

notes.title: New Kingdom Rush Vengance update: Primal Ravage coming September 29!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5487830/068ae643eec44a6c74dd735778ae40bc3ad2d48f.jpg[/img]

My loyal Generals!! 

[b]A NEW UPDATE is coming to Vengeance on September 29,[/b] and you need to prepare for it!
Some pesky and ancient-looking little dwarves are emerging from the ancient mines. 

Normally that would not be a problem for our troops, but they are bringing with them some disgusting lizard-like creatures that have very pointy claws and teeth, and they are keen on using them!

Since I am busy with other issues I am sending a new hero, Grosh, and a new tower, the Ignus Altar, on my behalf. You better not disappoint me or you will feel my rage!

While you are at it, punish those pesky dwarves that opened the mine passage and allied with their ancient counterparts. Apparently, there is no shortage of dwarves in these lands!

[i][b]Get your sword, shield, and spells ready! I am counting on you... or else…!
[/b][/i]

notes.title: New patch: Kingdom Rush v2.2 - Added Cloud support
notes.content:
Hey,

We've added Steam Cloud support to the game.
Now your save files will sync across any computer you play the game on!

If you have any problems, please let us know.



**** Update's sound issue fixed****

We had a bit of an issue after including Cloud Save were the sound went a bit bonkers... it's fixed now.

Thank you for your patience guys.
Stay awesome!



****About possible sound issues****

If any of you guys are experiencing problems with sound, please e-mail your output log as well as your computer specs to juanandres@ironhidegames.com

On windows it's located inside your Steam folder under:
steamapps\common\Kingdom Rush\Kingdom Rush_Data\

The log is called output_log.txt

If you are on mac it's in:
~/Library/Logs/Unity/

The file is Player.log.

notes.title: The Curse of Castle Blackburn is out!
notes.content:
Hello Steam fans!! We're happy to announce that The Curse of Castle Blackburn is now available!

From its unholy castle, Lord Blackburn has risen and threatens to enshroud the realms in perpetual darkness. Prepare to face dread and despair, as you embark on a quest to lift The Curse of Castle Blackburn!

Update features:
- 4 new stages of dread and despair! Battle through cities of the undead and forbidden cemeteries to reach the legendary cursed castle!
- 8 new unholy enemies! Undead hordes, revolting rat-men, fallen champions, and even wicked broom-flying witches!
- Boss fight: Face Lord Blackburn in an epic battle that will shake you to the bone!
- 5 new achievements!
- Easter eggs, specials, legendary monsters... and more!

We hope you enjoy it :)

notes.title: New patch: Kingdom Rush 1.12 is up!
notes.content:
For people still experiencing crashes and/or graphical glitches please make sure to have the game up to date as well as your graphics card driver.
If these problems still persist please e-mail me your log to juanandres@ironhidegames.com

Info on how to get your log here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/246420/discussions/0/630802343954715699/

And finally, here's the changelog for this new version:

Kingdom Rush 1.12

-Added a hotkey: press W to call a wave early.
-Added a hotkey: press Q to cancel rally point placement for barracks.
-Fixed Magma Elemental notification typo.
-Fixed pause overlay not showing during a stage.
-Fixed Foresaken Valley's lava spawn timer.
-Fixed Hero Portrait sometimes showing level 0 instead of 1.
-Fixed Forest Troll's attack point.
-Fixed Terminator achievement displays correctly in the game's achievement screen.
-Fixed damage icon for all mage towers.
-Fixed Dark Tower's torch layering.
-Fixed clicking on a notification icon will unselect fireball or reinforcement powers to avoid staying stuck with no mouse cursor.
-Adjusted Shadows Archer's arrow position.
-Fixed Quickmenu closing when the selected tower wasn't blocked during JT's and Veznan's block ability.
-Fixed being able to click the hero portrait while the hero is dead.
-Added version number to main menu.
